gloss: to wait eagerly; to look forward to

definitions.gloss: to wait eagerly for; to look forward to impatiently
definitions.explanation: To wait impatiently for something one is looking forward to; literally 'to make one's neck long', craning to see whether it is coming. Almost always in the て-form before {待|ま}つ: {首|くび}を{長|なが}くして{待|ま}つ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{首|くび}を{長|なが}くして⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The children are eagerly waiting for summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{首|くび}を{長|なが}くして⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I waited impatiently for the book I ordered to arrive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{首|くび}を{長|なが}くして⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: Every year my grandmother eagerly awaits the day her grandchildren come to visit.

notes:
Literally 'to lengthen the neck', stretching to see whether what one is waiting for has appeared. Almost always {首|くび}を{長|なが}くして⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {首|くび}を{長|なが}くして⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait eagerly
- {首|くび}を{長|なが}くして⟦{待|ま}っています→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: I'm really looking forward to it (in letters and messages)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい→待ち遠しい：14726_machidooshii⟧: long-awaited, can hardly wait — an adjective describing the thing awaited
- ⟦{楽|たの}しみにする→楽しみにする：26825_tanoshiminisuru⟧: to look forward to — neutral, without the impatience
